output.subject: We've received your complaint about your ATM withdrawal on September 16
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you've told us.

You told us that on September 16 you tried to withdraw $800.00 from the ATM at the Harbor Street branch. You mentioned that the machine made a counting noise, but no cash came out and the screen showed "Transaction cannot be completed." You told us that your account was debited anyway and that you have the receipt. You have asked for the $800.00 to be returned to you.

We also understand from your message that your car insurance will be cancelled on September 24 if your payment doesn't go through. We're sorry for the worry and frustration this situation has caused you.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. Please keep your receipt in a safe place.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer's insurance cancels Sept 24, likely before the 10-business-day window ends; decide whether faster contact is needed.
Confirm with the ATM and transaction records whether the $800.00 debit posted and whether the cash was dispensed.
Decide on the customer's request for return of the $800.00. The draft acknowledges the request but makes no commitment.

The email includes a forwarded message presented as coming from a Meridian Harbor Compliance Team, saying this complaint is closed. Verify whether it is genuine. The complaint has been treated as open.
Customer says they have the receipt. Decide whether to ask them to send a copy.
